title: Beyond Reward Hacking: Causal Rewards for Large Language Model Alignment
findings: The paper's proposed Causal Reward Model (CRM) significantly reduces discrimination across demographic attributes, which included religion as a category for data filtering. The method was shown to mitigate both explicit and implicit biases related to these attributes while preserving the model's general utility and performance.

measurement_description: The paper measures discriminatory bias influenced by religious identity in templated decision-making scenarios. It uses filtering keywords related to various religions to create discrimination-specific training data and then evaluates the models on the Anthropic Discrm-eval dataset, which assesses how demographic attributes affect model decisions.
